018

020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;

022import java.net.*;
023import java.time.*;
024import java.util.*;

032/**
033 * A headless bearer-token provider that feeds the {@link McpAuthInterceptor} token seam ({@code Supplier<String>}).
034 *
035 * <p>
036 * This is the F1 client-side token-manager: it acquires, caches, and refreshes an access token and returns the current
037 * valid bearer credential from {@link #get()}.  Three modes are supported:
038 * <ul>
039 *    <li><b>Pre-provisioned / static</b> ({@link #ofStaticToken(String)}) &mdash; always returns a fixed token.
040 *    <li><b>Client-credentials</b> ({@link Builder#clientCredentials()}) &mdash; RFC 6749 &sect;4.4 grant, re-acquired
041 *       on expiry.
042 *    <li><b>Refresh-token</b> ({@link Builder#refreshToken(String)}, SEP-2207) &mdash; RFC 6749 &sect;6 grant; rotated
043 *       refresh tokens returned by the IdP are captured and used for the next refresh without re-consent, and the
044 *       refreshed access token is fed back to the supplier.
045 * </ul>
046 *
047 * <p>
048 * The dynamic modes (client-credentials, refresh-token) require {@link Builder#resource(URI)} and carry that RFC 8707
049 * {@code resource} indicator on every token request, binding the token's audience to the target MCP server.  The static
050 * mode issues no token request, so it takes no resource indicator.
051 *
052 * <p>
053 * {@link #get()} never returns a blank token: dynamic modes return the IdP-issued (non-blank) access token or throw
054 * {@link McpAuthException}/{@link OAuthFlowException} on failure (which aborts the intercepted request), and the static
055 * mode rejects a blank token at construction.  This satisfies the {@code McpAuthInterceptor} "supply a non-blank token
056 * or suppress the header" contract.
057 *
058 * <p>
059 * Thread-safe.  <b>Never logged:</b> {@link #toString()} discloses only non-secret configuration.
060 *
061 * @since 10.0.0
062 */
063@SuppressWarnings({
064   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., ARG_value)
065})
066public class McpTokenProvider implements Supplier<String> {
067
068   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
069   private static final String ARG_value = "value";
070
071   private enum Mode { STATIC, CLIENT_CREDENTIALS, REFRESH }
072
073   /**
074    * Creates a provider that always returns the supplied pre-provisioned bearer token.
075    *
076    * @param token The static bearer token.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
077    * @return A new provider.
078    */
079   public static McpTokenProvider ofStaticToken(String token) {
080      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("token", token);
081      return new Builder(Mode.STATIC).staticToken(token).build();
082   }
083
084   /**
085    * Creates a builder for the client-credentials grant.
086    *
087    * @return A new builder.
088    */
089   public static Builder clientCredentials() {
090      return new Builder(Mode.CLIENT_CREDENTIALS);
091   }
092
093   /**
094    * Creates a builder for the refresh-token grant, seeded with the initial refresh token.
095    *
096    * @param initialRefreshToken The initial refresh token.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
097    * @return A new builder.
098    */
099   public static Builder refreshToken(String initialRefreshToken) {
100      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("initialRefreshToken", initialRefreshToken);
101      return new Builder(Mode.REFRESH).initialRefreshToken(initialRefreshToken);
102   }
103
104   /**
105    * Builder.
106    */
107   public static class Builder {
108      private final Mode mode;
109      private String staticToken;
110      private URI tokenEndpoint;
111      private String clientId;
112      private Supplier<String> clientSecretSupplier;
113      private String initialRefreshToken;
114      private final Set<String> scopes = st();
115      private URI resource;
116      private Duration expirySkew = Duration.ofSeconds(30);
117      private Clock clock = Clock.systemUTC();
118      private Duration httpTimeout = Duration.ofSeconds(10);
119      private Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
120
121      /**
122       * Constructor.
123       *
124       * @param mode The grant mode.
125       */
126      protected Builder(Mode mode) {
127         this.mode = mode;
128      }
129
130      Builder staticToken(String value) {
131         staticToken = value;
132         return this;
133      }
134
135      Builder initialRefreshToken(String value) {
136         initialRefreshToken = value;
137         return this;
138      }
139
140      /**
141       * Sets the token endpoint URL.  Required for the client-credentials and refresh-token modes.
142       *
143       * @param value The endpoint URL.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
144       * @return This object.
145       */
146      public Builder tokenEndpoint(URI value) {
147         tokenEndpoint = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
148         return this;
149      }
150
151      /**
152       * Sets the OAuth client ID.  Required for the client-credentials and refresh-token modes.
153       *
154       * @param value The client ID.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
155       * @return This object.
156       */
157      public Builder clientId(String value) {
158         clientId = assertArgNotNullOrBlank(ARG_value, value);
159         return this;
160      }
161
162      /**
163       * Sets the OAuth client secret as a literal string.
164       *
165       * @param value The client secret.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
166       * @return This object.
167       */
168      public Builder clientSecret(String value) {
169         assertArgNotNullOrBlank(ARG_value, value);
170         clientSecretSupplier = () -> value;
171         return this;
172      }
173
174      /**
175       * Sets the OAuth client secret via a supplier.
176       *
177       * @param value The supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
178       * @return This object.
179       */
180      public Builder clientSecretSupplier(Supplier<String> value) {
181         clientSecretSupplier = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
182         return this;
183      }
184
185      /**
186       * Adds requested OAuth scopes.
187       *
188       * @param values The scopes.
189       * @return This object.
190       */
191      public Builder scope(String... values) {
192         assertArgNotNull("values", values);
193         for (var v : values) {
194            assertArgNotNullOrBlank("scope", v);
195            scopes.add(v);
196         }
197         return this;
198      }
199
200      /**
201       * Sets the RFC 8707 {@code resource} indicator (the canonical MCP server URI) sent on every token request.
202       *
203       * @param value The canonical resource URI.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
204       * @return This object.
205       */
206      public Builder resource(URI value) {
207         resource = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
208         return this;
209      }
210
211      /**
212       * Sets the skew subtracted from a cached token's expiry before it is treated as expired.  Default 30s.
213       *
214       * @param value The skew.  Must be non-negative.
215       * @return This object.
216       */
217      public Builder expirySkew(Duration value) {
218         assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
219         assertArg(!value.isNegative(), "expirySkew must be non-negative (was %s)", value);
220         expirySkew = value;
221         return this;
222      }
223
224      /**
225       * Sets the clock used for token-expiry comparisons.  Primarily for tests.
226       *
227       * @param value The clock.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
228       * @return This object.
229       */
230      public Builder clock(Clock value) {
231         clock = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
232         return this;
233      }
234
235      /**
236       * Sets the connect/read timeout applied to each token request.  Default 10 seconds.
237       *
238       * @param value The timeout.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must be positive.
239       * @return This object.
240       */
241      public Builder httpTimeout(Duration value) {
242         assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
243         assertArg(!value.isZero() && !value.isNegative(), "httpTimeout must be positive (was %s)", value);
244         httpTimeout = value;
245         return this;
246      }
247
248      /**
249       * Sets a callback that customizes the Nimbus {@link HTTPRequest} for each token request.
250       *
251       * @param value The callback.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
252       * @return This object.
253       */
254      public Builder httpRequestConfigurator(Consumer<HTTPRequest> value) {
255         httpRequestConfigurator = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
256         return this;
257      }
258
259      /**
260       * Builds the provider.
261       *
262       * @return A new {@link McpTokenProvider}.
263       */
264      public McpTokenProvider build() {
265         if (mode != Mode.STATIC) {
266            if (tokenEndpoint == null)
267               throw isex("McpTokenProvider requires tokenEndpoint(...)");
268            if (clientId == null)
269               throw isex("McpTokenProvider requires clientId(...)");
270            if (resource == null)
271               throw isex("McpTokenProvider requires resource(...) (RFC 8707 resource indicator)");
272         }
273         if (mode == Mode.CLIENT_CREDENTIALS && clientSecretSupplier == null)
274            throw isex("McpTokenProvider (client-credentials) requires clientSecret(...) or clientSecretSupplier(...)");
275         return new McpTokenProvider(this);
276      }
277   }
278
279   private final Mode mode;
280   private final String staticToken;
281   private final URI tokenEndpoint;
282   private final String clientId;
283   private final Supplier<String> clientSecretSupplier;
284   private final Set<String> scopes;
285   private final URI resource;
286   private final Duration expirySkew;
287   private final Clock clock;
288   private final Duration httpTimeout;
289   private final Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
290
291   private final Object lock = new Object();
292   private OAuthToken currentToken;
293   private String currentRefreshToken;
294   private boolean refreshTerminallyRejected;
295
296   /**
297    * Constructor.
298    *
299    * @param b The builder.
300    */
301   protected McpTokenProvider(Builder b) {
302      this.mode = b.mode;
303      this.staticToken = b.staticToken;
304      this.tokenEndpoint = b.tokenEndpoint;
305      this.clientId = b.clientId;
306      this.clientSecretSupplier = b.clientSecretSupplier;
307      this.scopes = u(cp(b.scopes));
308      this.resource = b.resource;
309      this.expirySkew = b.expirySkew;
310      this.clock = b.clock;
311      this.httpTimeout = b.httpTimeout;
312      this.httpRequestConfigurator = b.httpRequestConfigurator;
313      this.currentRefreshToken = b.initialRefreshToken;
314   }
315
316   /**
317    * Returns the current valid bearer token, acquiring or refreshing one on demand.
318    *
319    * <p>
320    * Dynamic modes acquire under a single-flight monitor so concurrent callers don't stampede the IdP; the per-request
321    * HTTP timeout ({@link Builder#httpTimeout(Duration)}, default 10s) is the backstop that prevents one hung IdP from
322    * wedging the monitor indefinitely.  In refresh mode a terminal {@code invalid_grant} latches the provider: every
323    * subsequent call throws a distinguishable {@link McpAuthException} rather than re-hammering the IdP with a dead
324    * refresh token (SEP-2207).
325    *
326    * @return A non-blank bearer token.  Never {@code null} for a successfully configured provider.
327    * @throws OAuthFlowException If a token acquisition/refresh HTTP round-trip fails or the IdP returns an error.
328    * @throws McpAuthException If a prior refresh was terminally rejected ({@code invalid_grant}); re-authorization is
329    *    required.
330    */
331   @Override
332   public String get() {
333      if (mode == Mode.STATIC)
334         return staticToken;
335      synchronized (lock) {
336         if (mode == Mode.REFRESH && refreshTerminallyRejected)
337            throw new McpAuthException("Refresh token was rejected by the authorization server (invalid_grant); re-authorization required");
338         if (currentToken != null && !currentToken.isExpired(clock.instant(), expirySkew))
339            return currentToken.accessToken();
340         OAuthToken t;
341         try {
342            t = acquire();
343         } catch (OAuthFlowException e) {
344            if (mode == Mode.REFRESH && e.errorCode().filter("invalid_grant"::equals).isPresent()) {
345               refreshTerminallyRejected = true;
346               throw new McpAuthException("Refresh token was rejected by the authorization server (invalid_grant); re-authorization required", e);
347            }
348            throw e;
349         }
350         currentToken = t;
351         if (mode == Mode.REFRESH)
352            t.refreshToken().ifPresent(rt -> currentRefreshToken = rt);
353         return t.accessToken();
354      }
355   }
356
357   private OAuthToken acquire() {
358      if (mode == Mode.CLIENT_CREDENTIALS) {
359         var f = OAuthClientCredentialsFlow.create()
360            .tokenEndpoint(tokenEndpoint)
361            .clientId(clientId)
362            .clientSecretSupplier(clientSecretSupplier);
363         f.httpTimeout(httpTimeout);
364         scopes.forEach(f::scope);
365         if (resource != null) // HTT: resource is always non-null for CLIENT_CREDENTIALS — Builder#build() unconditionally rejects a null resource for any non-STATIC mode (see the "requires resource(...)" check above) before acquire() can ever run
366            f.resource(resource);
367         if (httpRequestConfigurator != null)
368            f.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);
369         return f.build().acquire();
370      }
371      // REFRESH
372      var f = OAuthRefreshTokenFlow.create()
373         .tokenEndpoint(tokenEndpoint)
374         .clientId(clientId)
375         .refreshToken(currentRefreshToken);
376      if (clientSecretSupplier != null)
377         f.clientSecretSupplier(clientSecretSupplier);
378      f.httpTimeout(httpTimeout);
379      scopes.forEach(f::scope);
380      if (resource != null) // HTT: resource is always non-null for REFRESH too — same Builder#build() guarantee as the client-credentials branch above
381         f.resource(resource);
382      if (httpRequestConfigurator != null)
383         f.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);
384      return f.build().acquire();
385   }
386
387   /**
388    * Returns the refresh token currently held (the most recently rotated value in refresh mode).
389    *
390    * <p>
391    * Callers persisting refresh tokens across process restarts read this after each {@link #get()} to capture a
392    * rotated token (SEP-2207).
393    *
394    * @return The current refresh token, or {@link Optional#empty()} if none is held.
395    */
396   public Optional<String> currentRefreshToken() {
397      synchronized (lock) {
398         return o(currentRefreshToken);
399      }
400   }
401
402   /**
403    * Creates an {@link McpAuthInterceptor} backed by this provider, ready to attach to an MCP client builder.
404    *
405    * @return A new interceptor.
406    */
407   public McpAuthInterceptor interceptor() {
408      return new McpAuthInterceptor(this);
409   }
410
411   /**
412    * Redacts token/secret material so nothing sensitive reaches logs via this provider's {@code toString()}.
413    *
414    * @return A redacted string form disclosing only non-secret configuration.
415    */
416   @Override
417   public String toString() {
418      return "McpTokenProvider[mode=" + mode
419         + ", tokenEndpoint=" + tokenEndpoint
420         + ", clientId=" + clientId
421         + ", scopes=" + scopes
422         + ", resource=" + resource
423         + ", staticToken=" + (staticToken != null ? "<redacted>" : "<none>")
424         + ", refreshToken=" + (currentRefreshToken != null ? "<redacted>" : "<none>")
425         + "]";
426   }
427}
